title: Fence recurring collectors by attempt and charter authority
summary: Persist launch and termination evidence independently from the permission to use a collected observation.
reusable_steps: Persist launch and termination evidence independently from the permission to use a collected observation
expected_outcome: A managed recurring collector should reserve its run and process identity before effects, bind snapshots to the reserved attempt, and revalidate the current charter at admission. Where a run cannot prove its effects, keep the exact attempt held until worker termination is recorded and an authenticated operator approves reconciliation. Confirmed pre-effect failures may retry at cadence. A temporary observation hold should leave independent rules and already-owned work eligible.
